notes.title: UPDATE SEPTEMBER 2021
notes.notes:
What's new:

 Increase Scroll speed with the V[/ b] key.
 FX effect when removing a tile.
 Some sound effects.
 New Image insert tab: Use the URL[/ b] of an image on the internet to insert it on the stage.
 New collection of Architecture Props.



Improvements:

 Spanish and English main menu.
 Lights with Intensity, Color and scale.
 Project name maximum 18 characters.



Corrections:

 Fix that enables scaling in characters.
 By default the selection method does not include moving a tab. To move tiles use keys 1, 2 or 3.
 Tree scale bug fix.
 Sphere and cell is already replicable and scalable.
 On Mac, opening the store first reverts the full screen and then opens the browser.
